arxiv-2404-02393.title: Backdoor Attacks on Multilingual Machine Translation
arxiv-2404-02393.creator: Jun Wang, Qiongkai Xu, Xuanli He, Benjamin I. P. Rubinstein, Trevor Cohn
arxiv-2404-02393.description: Abstract While multilingual machine translation (MNMT) systems hold substantial promise, they also have security vulnerabilities. Our research highlights that MNMT systems can be susceptible to a particularly devious style of backdoor attack, whereby an attacker injects poisoned data into a low-resource language pair to cause malicious translations in other languages, including high-resource languages.

arxiv-2503-16606.title: Looking for the 𝜸 \gamma -Ray Cascades of the KM3-230213A Neutrino Source
arxiv-2503-16606.creator: Tim Linden
arxiv-2503-16606.description: Abstract The extreme energy of the KM3-230213A event could transform our understanding of the most energetic sources in the Universe. However, it also reveals an inconsistency between the KM3NeT detection and strong IceCube constraints on the ultra-high energy neutrino flux.

arxiv-2507-21257.title: CompoST: A Benchmark for Analyzing the Ability of LLMs To Compositionally Interpret Questions in a QALD Setting
arxiv-2507-21257.creator: David Maria Schmidt, Raoul Schubert, Philipp Cimiano
arxiv-2507-21257.description: Abstract Language interpretation is a compositional process, in which the meaning of more complex linguistic structures is inferred from the meaning of their parts. Large language models possess remarkable language interpretation capabilities and have been successfully applied to interpret questions by mapping them to SPARQL queries. An open question is how systematic this interpretation process is.

arxiv-2509-11133.title: Vectorized 3D mesh refinement and implementation of primal hybrid FEM in MATLAB
arxiv-2509-11133.creator: Harish Nagula Mallesham, Sharat Gaddam, Jan Valdman, Sanjib Kumar Acharya
arxiv-2509-11133.description: Abstract In this article, we introduce a Face-to-Tetrahedron connectivity in MATLAB together with a vectorized 3D uniform mesh refinement technique. We introduce a MATLAB vectorized assembly of 3D lowest-order primal hybrid finite element matrices for a second-order elliptic problem. We introduce a parallel solver and a vectorized Schur complement solver to solve the associated linear problem.

arxiv-2511-02620.title: Verifying LLM Inference to Prevent Model Weight Exfiltration
arxiv-2511-02620.creator: Roy Rinberg, Adam Karvonen, Alexander Hoover, Daniel Reuter, Keri Warr, [2mm] Harvard University
arxiv-2511-02620.description: Abstract As large AI models become increasingly valuable assets, the risk of model weight exfiltration from inference servers grows accordingly. An attacker controlling an inference server may exfiltrate model weights by hiding them within ordinary model outputs, a strategy known as steganography.

arxiv-2511-05294.title: Local Technological Access, Income Disparities, and Job-Seeking in the United States Since 2010
arxiv-2511-05294.creator: Shaolong Wu
arxiv-2511-05294.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shaolong Wu. labor market, digital infrastructures strongly influence how individuals locate opportunities, build skills, and advance wages. Regional differences in computing access, broadband coverage, and digital literacy have significant labor implications for equity and sustainability. Drawing on longitudinal data from the NLSY97 (National Longitudinal Surveys of Youth) cohort, this study examines how place-based technological factors, personal demographics, household characteristics, and education shape income levels and decisions to seek new employment.
